model: canonical honeycomb retained edges; IID Bernoulli(p), s=Hx mod2, h=1{detector count>=2} Bernoulli(q), unmeasured rough tips
method: exact planar logical-sector Bayes inference; visible MAP reference; sparse LU numerical gates
risk_estimator: unconditional mean min(P0,P1); sampled-record standard error; never approximate-decoder risk
refinement: Independently extend transition neighborhoods and larger-size checks after broad-grid analysis. Retain all observed roots; do not force one threshold, symmetry or monotonicity in p.
acceptance: Matched-input exact posterior and geometry-cache validation; measured method speed comparison
Full-square independent measurements; deterministic endpoints labeled analytic, failures retained and gated
Three-size risk maps plus size-difference evidence and sampled crossing uncertainty; unresolved regions explicit
Independent larger-size transition checks; size drift separate from sampling uncertainty
PNG/SVG/PDF, data and provenance, report embed, active registry, actual rendered page and downloads verified
not_claimed: Rigorous thermodynamic phase classification from finite patches
Universal exponent or forced symmetric topology
runner_preflight: passed after auxiliary NumPy parity coercion fix

refinement_design.p_points: Quarter-interval subdivisions of every broad-grid crossing bracket, union over first two size pairs
refinement_design.confirmation_rule: For refined pilot cells, exclude the original first 256 records from crossing means/bootstrap. New p,q cells and L32 have fresh streams. Pilot-only cells are explicitly distinguishable.
refinement_design.uncertainty: iid confirmation-record bootstrap within a local p window; failure to locate root is reported; no thermodynamic or simultaneous coverage claim
